name: AI Tutor
summary: An Android app in development that helps students work through maths problems one step at a time — with Hint and Explain Differently — instead of revealing the final answer straight away.
visualNote: These screens show the real app UI running in its built-in sample mode, using the shipped example problem 3x + 7 = 22. They are not live AI responses, and do not show image recognition or a production deployment. The app's header currently shows its development name, Homework Tutor.
